grammar.title: According to with 按照
grammar.pattern: 按照 + 标准/规定，(主语) + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 按照 (ànzhào) means "according to, in accordance with" — it introduces a rule, standard, or plan that an action follows. It usually starts the sentence, before the subject.

grammar.title: Obviously with 显然
grammar.pattern: 显然，... / (主语) + 显然 + 动词/形容词短语
grammar.explanation: 显然 (xiǎnrán) means "obviously, clearly" — used when a conclusion is easy to see from the facts. It can start the sentence or sit right before the verb or adjective.

sentences.zh: 要是明天下雨，我们就不去了。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù bù qù le.
sentences.en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

sentences.zh: 要是你有问题，就问老师。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ yǒu wèntí, jiù wèn lǎoshī.
sentences.en: If you have a problem, ask the teacher.

sentences.zh: 要是他不来，我们就先开始。
sentences.pinyin: Yàoshi tā bù lái, wǒmen jiù xiān kāishǐ.
sentences.en: If he doesn't come, we'll start first.
